assertions.text: The VMU establishes a network of approved providers (during the pilot phase private, NGO, FBO providers) throughout Mbarara District.

The VSP payment terms are maintained with Payment Type (Selection from list of options Bi-Monthly/Monthly), Valid From (Date selection option), Valid up to (Date selection option), First Visit Consultation Fee (Only Numeric Entry, default 0), First follow up visit Consultation Fee (Only Numeric Entry, default 0), First second up visit Consultation Fee (Only Numeric Entry, default 0), and First visit Lab Fee (Only Numeric Entry, default 0).
The goal of the use case is to Review a Provider Claim Status.
The provider claim data from the VSP-submitted Treatment (claims) Form has been entered into the computer database.
The MSIU office has processed the claim.
The provider claim has passed the system's mandatory-information completeness check.
The use case is triggered when the VMU User receives a provider claim from the Service Providers via the Claim Processing module.
The VMU User accesses the Reports module to review claim status.
On the VSP screen, the VMU User selects the VSP whose claim status is to be viewed.
The system generates the report data from the database, which is populated by the Claim Processing module.
The system makes the following claim details available to the VMU User for review: Claim No, Date, Date of System Entry, Amount, Status, and Remarks.
The VMU User reviews the provider claim status and its supporting details.
Diverges from Main Flow Step 4 when the displayed claim status is not 'Accepted': the claim is stored in quarantine area and can proceed further from its status.
The provider claim status has been reviewed by the VMU User.
The system displays the reviewed claim's supporting details: Claim No, Date, Date of System Entry, Amount, Status, and Remarks.
